documents.text: Trinsic crime scene. method. Trinsic stables investigation. Investigate the ritualistic murder in the stables. Examine the crime scene for a key.
Trinsic suspect clue. explanation. murder suspect clue. Interview Spark, Gilberto, and Klog to identify the suspect (man with a hook) and his escape vessel (the Crown Jewel).

Trinsic exit password. acquisition. Blackbird password, obtain Trinsic exit password, pass Finnigan quiz. Report to Mayor Finnigan and pass his copy protection quiz with these answers:

Spektran latitude: 120
Terfin longitude: 120
Dagger Isle latitude: 0
Skara Brae latitude: 30
Deep Forest latitude: 60
Buccaneer's Den latitude: 60
Skara Brae longitude: 60

He will then give you the password 'Blackbird' to leave the city.
Fellowship package recipient. method. Elynor delivery, sealed package delivery, deliver Fellowship package, take sealed package to Elynor. Deliver a sealed package to Elynor in Minoc.
Destard errand. explanation. Batlin funds trap. Batlin assigns you to fetch 'funds' from Dungeon Destard — it's a trap, so be cautious.
Silent wisp search. location. silent wisp search, find silent wisp. Go to the Deep Forest and find the silent wisp.
Honey for emps. use. emp honey, Bee Cave honey purpose, get honey for emps, bribe emps with honey. Get honey from the Bee Cave to bribe the emps.

Emp whistle exchange. acquisition. get wisp whistle, negotiate for wisp whistle. Negotiate with the emps to get a wisp whistle. Use the whistle to communicate with the wisp, who demands Alagner's notebook from New Magincia in exchange for information.
Alagner answers request. method. Alagner request, learn answers to life and death. In New Magincia, Alagner asks you to learn the answers to life and death from Skara Brae.

Horance and the Soul Cage. method. Horance ritual, Well of Souls solution. Help the spirits by defeating the liche Horance. This involves brewing a potion, forging a Soul Cage, and destroying the Well of Souls. Caine will then reveal the 'answers'.
Alagner notebook collection. acquisition. collect notebook, return to Alagner for notebook. Return to Alagner to get his notebook.
Notebook exchange for Time Lord. use. notebook purpose, give notebook to wisp, contact Time Lord with notebook. Give the notebook to the wisp to contact the Time Lord.

Ethereal Ring preparation. method. Ethereal Ring enchantment, Penumbra blackrock, prepare Ethereal Ring, enchant Ethereal Ring, bring blackrock to Penumbra. Get blackrock for Penumbra, acquire the Ethereal Ring from Lord Draxinusom in Terfin, have it enchanted, and destroy the prism.
Tetrahedron destination. location. Deceit Tetrahedron. 1. Tetrahedron (Deceit):

Hourglass enchantment prerequisite. requirement. enchant hourglass prerequisite, enchant Hourglass after Tetrahedron, Hourglass enchantment condition. Get the Hourglass of Nicodemus, have it enchanted (after the Tetrahedron is down)
Sphere moongate route. method. Despise moongate route, solve Despise moongate puzzle, navigate Sphere moongates. navigate the moongate puzzle (down, up, down, down, up) to destroy the prism.

Caddellite helmet material. acquisition. Caddellite helmet forging, Zorn helmets, forge Caddellite helmets, make Caddellite helmets, get Caddellite from meteorites, wear helmets against Cube. Find Caddellite from meteorites in the northeast seas, have Zorn in Minoc forge helmets, and wear them to safely destroy the final generator.
Cube prism truth. use. Cube prism purpose, use Cube prism to expose lies. Use the Cube prism to reveal the Fellowship's lies and identify the conspirators.
Hook key search. acquisition. Hook key, recover Hook key in Buccaneers Den. In Buccaneer's Den, track down Hook and recover the key you need.
Final Hythloth descent. method. endgame dungeon. Travel to the Isle of the Avatar and descend into Hythloth.

Generator prism pedestals. use. three prism placement, place generator prisms, disable Black Gate power beam. Place the three generator prisms on their pedestals to disable the Black Gate's power beam.
Rudyom wand final use. use. destroy Black Gate tool, use Rudyom wand on Black Gate, destroy Black Gate with wand. Finally, use Rudyom's Wand on the Black Gate to destroy it and save Britannia.

Golden Ankh deed. acquisition. Golden Ankh deed, magic crystal for Isle of Fire, ask Lord British about tremors, get Golden Ankh deed. Speak to Lord British about the tremors at the start. He grants the deed to the ship Golden Ankh and a magic crystal.
Isle of Fire landing. location. Isle of Fire landing cove, sail from Vesper, beach at Isle of Fire northern cove. Sail from Vesper to the newly risen Isle of Fire and beach at the northern cove.

Erethian test background. method. Erethian tests, statues tests, start Tests of Truth Love and Courage. Meet Erethian (west wing) for background on the Tests and the Shrine of Principles. The statues initiate each Test. Love's Moongate is behind a secret wall in Erethian's room. Courage's Moongate is to the right. Truth teleports you directly.
Castle Love moongate. location. Love test entrance, enter Test of Love, reach Love moongate. Love's Moongate is behind a secret wall in Erethian's room.
Castle Courage moongate. location. Courage test entrance, Truth test entrance, enter Test of Courage, reach Courage moongate. Courage's Moongate is to the right. Truth teleports you directly.

True locket route. method. true locket, hood secret wall, find true locket, solve Test of Truth. The solution lies before the labyrinth: find the 'hood' and move north through a secret wall to reach the true locket.
Truth optional loot. method. Truth optional puzzles, skip optional Truth puzzles, optional Truth puzzles required. Optional puzzles offer dangerous but valuable loot.

Stone of Castambre ritual. method. Stone of Castambre, Bollux heart, revive Adjhar, perform Stone of Castambre ritual twice, revive Adjhar then give Bollux a heart. Aid Bollux and Adjhar using the Stone of Castambre ritual. Perform it twice—first to revive Adjhar, then again to give Bollux a heart.
Talisman of Love reward. acquisition. Talisman of Love. Receive the Talisman of Love when done.

Courage dragon preparation. combat. Courage dragon tactics, prepare for Test of Courage, use sleep potions on dragons, solve Courage helmet pedestal puzzle. Use sleep potions on dragons, search bodies for magic armor, solve the helmet pedestal puzzle, defeat Dracothraxus for the Ether Gem, then return—this test continues later.
Ether Gem acquisition. acquisition. Dracothraxus reward, obtain Ether Gem, defeat Dracothraxus for Ether Gem. defeat Dracothraxus for the Ether Gem
Arcadion and the mirror. method. Arcadion mirror, daemon Ether Gem, free Arcadion via mirror, put Arcadion into Ether Gem. Free Arcadion into the Ether Gem via the mirror.

Black Sword forging. method. Black Sword forge, sharpen Black Sword, forge Black Sword, heat hammer sharpen blade, bind daemon to Black Sword. Heat and hammer the blade at the forge until it's sharp, then bind the daemon to forge the Black Sword.

Courage completion with sword. method. finish Courage test, finish Test of Courage with Black Sword, invoke Black Sword power. Return to Dracothraxus and invoke the Black Sword's power to finish the test.

Dark Core assembly. method. Dark Core lenses, museum lenses purpose, assemble museum lenses and talismans, report to Lord British for Forge reward. Assemble the two museum lenses and the Talismans of Principle on the Dark Core per instructions, then report to Lord British for his reward.

Forge of Virtue stat reward. explanation. Forge stat reward, claim Forge of Virtue reward, Forge reward 30 or 60. Lord British will reward you by raising your Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence to 30 (or even 60 in some versions).

Free Weston! solution. method. Free Weston! walkthrough, why Weston is in jail, get Weston released, plead Westons case to Lord British. Weston is jailed in Lord British's castle for stealing an apple. Plead his case to Lord British for his release.
Where Does Patterson go at Night? solution. method. Where Does Patterson go at Night? walkthrough. Follow Patterson after a Fellowship meeting to Candice's house. Confront him about his affair.
Miranda's Law solution. method. Miranda's Law walkthrough. Take Miranda's bill to clean up Lock Lake to Lord Heather in Cove for a signature, then return it.
Nastassia's Father solution. method. Nastassia's Father walkthrough. Ask the Emp Trellek in the Deep Forest about Julius. He will reveal Julius was a hero. Report this back to Nastassia.

Owen the Shipwright, Hero or Fraud? solution. method. Owen the Shipwright, Hero or Fraud? walkthrough. Get the original ship plans from the hermit Karl. Show them to Julia the tinker, who confirms the design is flawed. Present the evidence to Mayor Burnside.

The Honor Flag solution. method. The Honor Flag walkthrough. Either fight three duels for Sprellic, or more cleverly, have the armorer Kliftin weave a replica of the stolen flag and give it to the fighters.
Blorn's Accusations solution. method. Blorn's Accusations walkthrough. Speak to the accused gargoyle, Lap-Lem. He was the victim. Confront Blorn to get Lap-Lem's stolen amulet back and return it.

Where does Catherine Go? solution. method. Where does Catherine Go? walkthrough. Follow Catherine to the gargoyle side of town. She listens to stories from an elder gargoyle. Keeping this secret is the peaceful option.
Balayna's Doubts solution. method. Balayna's Doubts walkthrough. A quest highlighting the Fellowship's sinister nature. Reporting Balayna's doubts to Rankin leads to her death or disappearance.
Brion's Orrery solution. method. Brion's Orrery walkthrough. Buy a special crystal from the adventurer Addom for 20 gold and give it to Brion so he can power the observatory's orrery.

Who wants to destroy the Shrine? solution. method. Who wants to destroy the Shrine? walkthrough. Investigate Sarpling's home to find a note implicating Runeb in a plot against the Altars. Confront Runeb to resolve the threat.
Mysterious Monk solution. method. Mysterious Monk walkthrough. Kreg is a criminal in hiding. Research court records to discover his identity and confront him, which will provoke an attack.
Who Defaced Lord British? solution. method. Who Defaced Lord British? walkthrough. A lengthy investigation reveals the knight Pendaran is the vandal. Report this to Lord John-Paul for judgment.
Tory's Baby solution. method. Tory's Baby walkthrough. The baby, Riky, is at the Shrine of Honour (142S, 9W). Defeat the harpies and return him to his mother.

Weston appeal. method. release Weston, Weston apple, why Weston is in jail, get Weston released, plead Westons case to Lord British. Weston is jailed in Lord British's castle for stealing an apple. Plead his case to Lord British for his release.
Patterson affair evidence. explanation. Patterson Candice affair. Follow Patterson after a Fellowship meeting to Candice's house. Confront him about his affair.
Miranda bill signature. method. Lock Lake bill, Lord Heather signature. Take Miranda's bill to clean up Lock Lake to Lord Heather in Cove for a signature, then return it.
Julius and Trellek. explanation. Julius hero, Trellek Nastassia. Ask the Emp Trellek in the Deep Forest about Julius. He will reveal Julius was a hero. Report this back to Nastassia.

Owen ship plans investigation. method. Karl ship plans, Julia ship design. Get the original ship plans from the hermit Karl. Show them to Julia the tinker, who confirms the design is flawed. Present the evidence to Mayor Burnside.

Honor Flag peaceful alternative. method. Kliftin replica, Sprellic duels alternative. Either fight three duels for Sprellic, or more cleverly, have the armorer Kliftin weave a replica of the stolen flag and give it to the fighters.
Lap-Lem stolen amulet. method. Lap-Lem amulet, Blorn theft. Speak to the accused gargoyle, Lap-Lem. He was the victim. Confront Blorn to get Lap-Lem's stolen amulet back and return it.

Catherine peaceful secret. method. Catherine stories, keep Catherine secret. Follow Catherine to the gargoyle side of town. She listens to stories from an elder gargoyle. Keeping this secret is the peaceful option.
Balayna report consequence. explanation. Rankin Balayna consequence. Reporting Balayna's doubts to Rankin leads to her death or disappearance.
Brion orrery crystal. acquisition. Addom crystal price, power orrery. Buy a special crystal from the adventurer Addom for 20 gold and give it to Brion so he can power the observatory's orrery.
Runeb shrine plot evidence. method. Sarpling note, Runeb Altars. Investigate Sarpling's home to find a note implicating Runeb in a plot against the Altars. Confront Runeb to resolve the threat.
Kreg court records. method. Kreg hidden identity, Kreg confrontation. Kreg is a criminal in hiding. Research court records to discover his identity and confront him, which will provoke an attack.
Pendaran vandal evidence. explanation. statue vandal Pendaran. A lengthy investigation reveals the knight Pendaran is the vandal. Report this to Lord John-Paul for judgment.
Riky rescue. method. Riky baby rescue, Tory baby location. The baby, Riky, is at the Shrine of Honour (142S, 9W). Defeat the harpies and return him to his mother.
Iolo party advice. explanation. Iolo automatic recruitment. Joins automatically at the start.
Sentri party advice. explanation. Sentri recruitment limit. Will not join if party size is > 5. Offers free DEX training.
Katrina party advice. explanation. Katrina recruitment limit. Will not join if party size is > 5. Generally a poor choice due to low stats.
Julia party advice. explanation. Julia rejoin warning. Will not join if party size is > 5. Will not rejoin if dismissed.
Jaana party advice. explanation. Jaana free healing. Can periodically heal the party for free. Only companion with innate magic.
Spark party advice. explanation. Spark training growth. Gains training points at double rate. Huge damage potential.

Training point gains. explanation. training points per level, gain training points, spend training points at trainers. Upon leveling up, characters gain 3 training points. Spend these at trainers to increase attributes.

Fighter training order. method. fighter Combat Dexterity training, train Combat before Dexterity, improve fighter attributes. For Fighters: Train Combat until it's 1 point higher than Dexterity. Then, train only Dexterity. This raises both stats efficiently.

Avatar magic training order. method. Avatar Intelligence Magic training, train Intelligence before Magic, increase Avatar mana pool. For the Avatar (Mage): Raise Intelligence first to create a large gap with the Magic skill. Then train Magic for massive mana pool increases.

Sentri free training effect. explanation. Sentri Dexterity Combat, train Dexterity for free, Sentri free Combat boost. Free Training: Sentri in Britain offers free Dexterity training, which also boosts Combat.
Glass Sword effect. use. Glass Sword effect. Glass Sword: Extremely High Damage (1 use). Type: 1H Weapon.
Magebane effect. use. Magebane effect. Magebane: Drains Mana on Hit. Type: 1H Weapon.
Triple Crossbow effect. use. Triple Crossbow effect. Triple Crossbow: Fires 3 Bolts. Type: Ranged.
Sword of Defense effect. use. Sword of Defense effect. Sword of Defense: Adds to Armor Value. Type: 1H Weapon.

Slimes combat tactics. combat. Slimes tactics. Slimes: They duplicate when struck, which makes careless attacks messy but permits controlled experience farming. The guide recommends low-damage weapon. Threat: Controlled.

Stone Harpy combat tactics. combat. Stone Harpy tactics. Stone Harpy: Immune to magic and enchanted weapons. Fight with non-magical attacks; a Glass Sword is also highly effective. The guide recommends mundane attacks. Threat: High.

Liches combat tactics. combat. Liches tactics. Liches: Dangerous spellcasters. Drain their mana with Magebane to shut down the part of their arsenal that makes them lethal. The guide recommends magebane. Threat: Severe.

Dragons combat tactics. combat. Dragons tactics. Dragons: Their large health pool punishes a drawn-out fight. A Glass Sword can often end the encounter in a single hit. The guide recommends glass sword. Threat: Severe.
Seance use. use. Seance spell use. Required to speak with the spirits of Skara Brae and progress the main investigation.
Destroy Trap use. use. Destroy Trap spell use. Required to reach the Tetrahedron Generator; also makes trapped containers safer to handle.
Mark & Recall use. use. Mark & Recall spell use. Creates a reusable return point, dramatically reducing cross-map travel and supply runs.
Unlock Magic use. use. Unlock Magic spell use. Opens magically sealed doors and containers that ordinary keys cannot address.
Heal & Cure use. use. Heal & Cure spell use. The dependable core of party recovery between dangerous encounters.
Mass Might use. use. Mass Might spell use. Raises the party's strength together, making it a strong pre-combat buff.
Armageddon use. use. Armageddon spell use. Kills nearly every NPC in Britannia and breaks most quests. Keep it as a curiosity, not a normal field spell.
Wisp whistle. acquisition. negotiate for wisp whistle. Negotiate with the emps to get a wisp whistle.
Wisp whistle. use. communicate with wisp. Use the whistle to communicate with the wisp, who demands Alagner's notebook from New Magincia in exchange for information.
Ethereal Ring. acquisition. get Ethereal Ring from Draxinusom. acquire the Ethereal Ring from Lord Draxinusom in Terfin

Ethereal Ring. method. prepare Ethereal Ring, enchant Ethereal Ring, bring blackrock to Penumbra. Get blackrock for Penumbra, acquire the Ethereal Ring from Lord Draxinusom in Terfin, have it enchanted, and destroy the prism.

Caddellite helmets. acquisition. forge Caddellite helmets, make Caddellite helmets, get Caddellite from meteorites, wear helmets against Cube. Find Caddellite from meteorites in the northeast seas, have Zorn in Minoc forge helmets, and wear them to safely destroy the final generator.

Caddellite helmets. use. forge Caddellite helmets, make Caddellite helmets, get Caddellite from meteorites, wear helmets against Cube. 3. Cube (Meditation Retreat): Find Caddellite from meteorites in the northeast seas, have Zorn in Minoc forge helmets, and wear them to safely destroy the final generator.

Black Sword. acquisition. forge Black Sword, heat hammer sharpen blade, bind daemon to Black Sword. Heat and hammer the blade at the forge until it's sharp, then bind the daemon to forge the Black Sword.
Black Sword. use. finish Test of Courage with Black Sword, invoke Black Sword power. Return to Dracothraxus and invoke the Black Sword's power to finish the test.
Golden Ankh. acquisition. ask Lord British about tremors, get Golden Ankh deed. Speak to Lord British about the tremors at the start. He grants the deed to the ship Golden Ankh and a magic crystal.
Golden Ankh. route. sail Golden Ankh to Isle of Fire. Sail from Vesper to the newly risen Isle of Fire and beach at the northern cove.
Julia. recruitment. . Will not join if party size is > 5. Will not rejoin if dismissed.
Julia. location. . The guide lists Julia at Minoc, Tinker Shop. This is a guide location, not a report of their current position.
Julia. stats. . Julia: Strength 12, Dexterity 14, Intelligence 18, Combat 8. Tags: frontline.

Test of Truth. explanation. Test of Truth definition, complete Test of Truth, solve Test of Truth, skip optional Truth puzzles. A maze of deception involving false lockets. The solution lies before the labyrinth: find the 'hood' and move north through a secret wall to reach the true locket. Optional puzzles offer dangerous but valuable loot.

Test of Love. explanation. Test of Love definition, complete Test of Love, perform Test of Love ritual. Aid Bollux and Adjhar using the Stone of Castambre ritual. Perform it twice—first to revive Adjhar, then again to give Bollux a heart. Receive the Talisman of Love when done.

Test of Courage. explanation. Test of Courage definition, prepare for Test of Courage, use sleep potions on dragons, solve Courage helmet pedestal puzzle. Fight through mages, golems, and dragons. Use sleep potions on dragons, search bodies for magic armor, solve the helmet pedestal puzzle, defeat Dracothraxus for the Ether Gem, then return—this test continues later.
Arcadion. explanation. Arcadion identity, bound daemon Arcadion. Arcadion: The bound daemon of the Blackrock Sword—central to the Forge of Virtue.
Lord British. identity. Lord British, King of All Britannia. Lord British rules Britannia as its king. He is an old friend of the Avatar and shares the Avatar's original homeland, Earth.

Guardian. identity. The Guardian identity. In Ultima VII: The Black Gate, the Guardian is a powerful, hostile being from another dimension. He seeks domination and control of Britannia, and the Time Lord urges the Avatar to oppose him.
Time Lord. identity. Time Lord identity. In Ultima VII: The Black Gate, the Time Lord is a being whose work is to keep time flowing smoothly through space. He helps the Avatar oppose the Guardian.
Guardian. purpose. Guardian goal. The Guardian wants power and domination: he conquers other worlds and has turned his attention to Britannia.
Time Lord. purpose. Time Lord request. The Time Lord wants the Avatar to free him and help oppose the Guardian.
Time Lord. relationship. Time Lord and Guardian relationship. The Time Lord and the Guardian are opponents: the Time Lord asks the Avatar to fight the Guardian, who has trapped him.

Talisman of Love. acquisition. obtain Talisman of Love, earn Talisman of Love, Talisman of Love ritual. Aid Bollux and Adjhar using the Stone of Castambre ritual. Perform it twice—first to revive Adjhar, then again to give Bollux a heart. Receive the Talisman of Love when done.

Black Sword. method. forge Black Sword from Ether Gem, make Black Sword, ask Erethian about artifact of power. Ask Erethian about the artifact of power. Free Arcadion into the Ether Gem via the mirror. Heat and hammer the blade at the forge until it's sharp, then bind the daemon to forge the Black Sword.

Training rubber-band effect. explanation. rubber band training, secondary skill training effect. The key is the "rubber-band effect": training a secondary skill (Combat, Magic) yields huge gains if it's far below its primary attribute (Dexterity, Intelligence).
Iolo. location. Iolo guide location. The guide lists Iolo at Trinsic. This is a guide location, not a report of their current position.
Spark. location. Spark guide location. The guide lists Spark at Trinsic, Christopher's House. This is a guide location, not a report of their current position.
Sentri. location. Sentri guide location. The guide lists Sentri at Britain, Training Hall. This is a guide location, not a report of their current position.
Jaana. location. Jaana guide location. The guide lists Jaana at Cove, Healer's Shop. This is a guide location, not a report of their current position.
Katrina. location. Katrina guide location. The guide lists Katrina at New Magincia. This is a guide location, not a report of their current position.
Brion's Orrery reward. reward. Orrery quest reward, reward for Brion’s orrery. Brion activates the orrery
